column2: `/implement` step 5 mav/coder resume-handoff calls `step-5-resume.sh --ready-to-commit`, not `python/cli.py implement step-5-resume`. that shell wrapper still runs `review-and-fix commit-fixes --stage-all` inline and emits `commit_outcome`, not `next_action`. the plan refactors `step5_resume_main` and thins skill prose to parse `next_action`, but leaves the production hot path unchanged. the third duplicated hand-parse site stays live; durable stall seeding and `next_action=stall` routing will not run for resume-handoff.

`step-5-resume.sh` and `_step5_resume_commit_phase` probe `git status --porcelain` after `commit_outcome` `ok`/`noop` and fail closed before re-entering `review-and-fix step5`. the planned shared `commit_route_main` gates only on `commit_outcome` and explicitly omits porcelain for self-review and step 7. reusing it verbatim for resume-handoff without a resume-only probe lets a dirty tree re-enter the review loop and breaks the hardened contract in `step-5-resume.md` and `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh`. thinning orchestrator prose to `next_action` only also risks porcelain failures reaching step 6/18 without `resume-handoff-commit-failed` durable bail if stall seeding is not wired on that path.

`make lint` runs `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh`, which requires current `step-5-resume.sh` commit/porcelain needles and skill strings for `commit_outcome` parsing, `stall_reason=review-fix-commit-failed`, and resume-handoff lacks-envelope rules. the plan removes that orchestrator parsing in favor of `next_action` but lists only `may_update` for `test-implement-fence-shape.sh`. implementers can pass pytest yet fail `make lint` after skill-only edits.

`commit-route` will emit orchestrator routing kvs (`next_action`, commit kvs). verbs like `implement step-8-oos-checkpoint` are in `_machine_stdout_keys` so quiet mode sets `larch_quiet_disable` and does not suppress machine stdout. without enrollment, direct skill fences for self-review, resume-handoff, and step 7 may miss `next_action` under quiet runs.

resume-handoff uses an immediate-background `step-5-resume.sh` fence whose orchestrator parses stdout after notification. if `commit-route` returns non-zero on stall without a documented rc=0 envelope (unlike `step8_oos_checkpoint_main`), the wrapper may be classified as generic preflight failure instead of `next_action=stall`.

skills/implement/scripts/step-5-resume.sh:108-140 [scope-reduction] resume handoff hot path not wired to commit-route. scenario: /implement invokes step-5-resume.sh --ready-to-commit (skills/implement/skill.md:650), not implement step-5-resume. the plan updates step5_resume_main only (plan.txt implement_dispatch.py) and thins orchestrator prose to parse next_action, but lists no change to step-5-resume.sh or the skill fence. the bash wrapper will keep emitting commit_outcome without next_action=stall and without seeding ship-pr-state.sh; orchestrator will not reach step 18 with durable stall state on mav/coder commit failure.

the planned `commit-route` contract emits `next_action=stall|continue`, and skill/orchestrator prose will branch on it in the lacks-envelope path. but `relay_commit_kvs` in `step-5-resume.sh` and `_step5_resume_relay_commit_kvs` in `implement_dispatch.py` only forward `committed`/`error`/`sha`/`commit_outcome`. the wrapper plan says "relay commit kvs" on stall/continue, not `next_action`. after `commit_outcome` parsing is removed from skill.md, combined wrapper stdout seen by the orchestrator will lack `next_action=`, so `next_action=stall` routing and lacks-envelope branching cannot fire even when `commit-route` seeded durable bail and returned rc 0.

current skill.md (lines 655–657) has a second lacks-envelope branch: `commit_outcome=ok|noop` without `step5_review_status=` routes to step 5 preflight/resume failure (skip to step 18), not step 6. the plan replaces the first branch with `next_action=stall` and adds non-zero rc without `next_action=continue` → preflight, but never states that `next_action=continue` without `step5_review_status=` still requires the review-loop envelope before step 6. after a successful `commit-route`, a later `review-and-fix step5` preflight failure (wrapper rc zero or non-zero) with no `step5_review_status=` could fall through toward step 6 and violate never #4. round-1 finding_6 stays open under the thinned prose.

the `for script in [...]` block at `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh:99–118` requires `bash "$implement_tmpdir/larch-run.sh" python/cli.py review-and-fix commit-fixes --stage-all` in skill.md. the plan swaps self-review to `implement commit-route --site step5-self-review` but the harness update section does not mention this launcher row. `make lint` will fail after skill edits even if other needles are updated.

the plan adds a bounded `commit-route` diagnostic and appends it with `run-log append-failure`, but does not require `--redact`. raw `git commit` or hook stdout/stderr can then be copied into committed execution issues, expanding the old prompt-side `error=` surface into an unredacted log surface.

the plan makes commit-route return non-zero with no next_action when durable stall seeding fails, but the planned self-review and step 7 prose only branches on stall or continue. missing, duplicated, malformed, or non-zero-without-next_action output on those foreground fences can fall through or halt inconsistently instead of fail-closing before step 6, step 7a, or step 8.

the issue requires all three commit sites to collapse to branch on `next_action` (`continue` or skip to step 18). self-review bullets already list `continue`, `stall`, and invalid-envelope cases. the planned step 7 replacement lists only `next_action=continue` and invalid-envelope handling and never states that on `next_action=stall` the orchestrator must skip to step 18. an implementer can wire `commit-route` correctly yet leave step 7 without the durable-bail skip path that today runs on `commit_outcome` failure.

`_step5_resume_commit_phase` lacks an explicit `next_action=stall` fail-closed return when the commit-route process rc is 0. after refactor, `commit_route` can return 0 with `next_action=stall` (mirroring `step8_oos_checkpoint`). if success is mapped only to `commit_rc==0`, the phase returns `none` and `step5_resume_main` proceeds to review-and-fix step5 after a seeded commit-phase stall. that violates the plan and breaks python parity with the shell wrapper, which exits before step5 on `next_action=stall`.

the planned commit-route delegation replaces the inline commit-fixes block with a bare `implement commit-route` call but does not carry forward the `set +e` / capture / `set -e` guard under `set -euo pipefail`. on a non-zero commit-route return without `next_action` (stall-seed failure, usage error, invalid envelope), errexit can abort the wrapper before stdout is captured or `next_action`/`commit_outcome` are relayed, so the orchestrator cannot reach lacks-envelope branch 3 and may mis-route to generic preflight failure. the structure harness drops the pin at `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh:369` without adding an errexit-safe commit-route replacement.

planned self-review and step 7 invalid commit-route envelope handling says log to warnings and do not proceed, but unlike resume-handoff lacks-envelope branch 3 it never sets `stall_tracking=true` or skips to step 18. on seed failure or malformed stdout (no `next_action`), foreground fences can halt mid-step-5/7 without the teardown/stall-recovery path that `commit_outcome` failures and resume-handoff invalid envelopes use, stranding the session without step 18 cleanup.

moving the whole commit-failure tree into commit-route includes execution-issues logging. the plan's ok/noop porcelain branch seeds durable stall and emits `next_action=stall`, but only the `commit_outcome` failure branch calls `_commit_route_log_failure`; porcelain tests assert only state. a dirty/probe-failed resume handoff can reach step 18 with durable state but no committed failure log.
